messages:
maria: FYI opened a tiny docs PR to clarify how autoscale cooldown interacts with tenant isolation and preemption. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1462

maria: tl;dr: show a minimal YAML + the API error payload so teams know to handle 429 vs preemption errors differently. also add a short translator context for the 429 message.

sam: good idea. can we include a sentence about expected user-visible latency during scale-up so product teams can set UX expectations? one line should be enough.

anya: agree. suggest: "Scale-up latency depends on warmstart state; plan for 100-500ms for warm caches, 1-6s for cold starts." short and fuzzy is fine.

leo: dropping a proposal YAML here for the PR comment:
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  cooldown_seconds: 90
  burst_capacity: 1
  queue_limit: 250
  fallback_policy: "reserved-pool-fallback"
```

leo: and a recommended explanatory sentence: "If queue_limit is reached, requests receive a 429 and autoscaler will attempt to expand capacity; eviction of lower-priority tenants may be considered only when preventable capacity is unavailable."

maria: tweak: "eviction of lower-priority tenants may be considered" -> "eviction of lower-priority tenants may be triggered"? feels clearer.

jen: for i18n: please add inline comments for translators like: // context: 429 means the request queue reached capacity; callers should back off and retry after the interval in `retry_after_seconds`.

anya: adding the error payload example to PR body:
```json
{
  "error": "queue_capacity_exceeded",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 45,
  "hint": "backoff_or_use_alternate_region"
}
```

maria: nice. docs-bot: running linkcheck.

docs-bot: linkcheck: 1 broken anchor: #eviction-behavior (line 78)

maria: thanks bot. i'll fix anchor and push a tiny follow-up commit. also will add Sam's one-liner about expected scale-up latency.

leo: editorial note: avoid the term "preemption" alone; spell out "preemption (eviction to free node resources)" once, then use "preemption". keeps legal and security teams happy.

maria: good call. i'll amend language and include translator context strings for that sentence. plan: anya to copycheck the JSON payload formatting, leo to sync fallback_policy name with infra examples, jen to add i18n comments. target: tomorrow morning merge if CI green.

sam: will review ASAP after the fix. thanks all! :sparkles:
